subject: Zen Word churn_prob — supplied Android 2.44.0 / versionCode 189
scope: Static analysis of supplied APK DEX and XAPK ARM64 IL2CPP; no account or live backend inspection.

origin.client: UserTagMgr.ChurnProbTagUpdate 0x183f4b0; Single.TryParse then store float at instance offset 0x70
origin.model: No scoring formula, input features, model weights, prediction horizon or calibration established from the package.
origin.eloRelationship: No local ELO-to-churn conversion found; backend relationship unknown.

refresh.startup: RemoteTagProcessor.g reads persisted scalar/list tags before remote refresh.
refresh.request: ConfigResultManager.h + first ColdStartToForeground -> initial request, mode ALL.
refresh.afChanged: A change of local attribution data can schedule a further request, mode EXCLUDE_AF_PUSH_API; remote tags accept this mode.
refresh.notRiskTimer: Default 20000ms, maximum 4 additional AF_PUSH_API requests; RemoteTagProcessor inherits a filter that rejects this mode. This is not a churn refresh timer.
refresh.periodic: No per-level or fixed-interval churn recomputation in this client chain; server recomputation cadence unknown.
refresh.storage: Android SharedPreferences user_tag_sdk_remote_sp_file; risk tag stored as tag_id/tag_value JSON. No risk TTL check in this chain.

missingAndCache.neverReceived: Game float starts at 0; risk-filter groups 1 and 2 reject it.
missingAndCache.validNewValue: Parse and overwrite, with no smoothing/averaging or clamp to [0,1].
missingAndCache.networkFailure: Does not itself clear prior tags; prior cached risk may remain.
missingAndCache.absentOrEmptyScalarArray: Android remote scalar processor returns without clearing prior scalar tags.
missingAndCache.nonemptyScalarArrayWithoutChurn: Android replaces prior scalar map. If churn was previously present, change notification leads the game parser to zero.
missingAndCache.invalidScalarText: Ordinary Single.TryParse failure yields 0; no explicit finite-number guard.
missingAndCache.nullCallbackData: ChurnProbTagUpdate returns without modifying the field.
missingAndCache.notification: Initial data/late subscriber backfill; subsequent key-value changes notify the registered churn listener.

gates.classification: Conditional dynamic easing of a restored level, plus separately configured daily warm-up; not a verified ELO-to-bank control loop.

time.reset: last entry timestamp overwritten on each StartGameMode

attempts.A: AnswerProgress.Count; answer-completion records. SetBoxFind writes this list.
attempts.E: ExtraProgress.Count; separately collected extra words. AddFindExtraWord writes this list and the separate in-memory _finishWords list.
attempts.T: TrialAttemptsCount; increments only for LengthError (1) or Error (2), not RepeatAnswer (5) or RepeatExtra (6).
attempts.veryShortInput: Length<2 returns None, not a trial; length>=2 but below minimum answer length counts only when the length-error experiment returns LengthError.

experiment2.otherGroup: churn function returns true; other eligibility checks remain
experiment2.dateOrigin: HalfLevelEasierTest2FirstTriggerTime initialized on first call of the decay-days helper; subsequent date-only calendar difference. High-churn group2 branch bypasses this helper.
experiment2.tagOrigin: Remote tag churn_prob; no local main-ELO-to-tag conversion found.

extraAction.change: If onlyExtra nonempty, merge it into extra, clear onlyExtra, set AdjustExtraConfigRatio=1.
extraAction.whatDoesNotChange: This branch does not remove target slots or replace the letter wheel.
extraAction.ratioMeaning: Observed writer sets 1, CheckRestore reads >0 as a reason to preserve restored state. This is not evidence of a 100% unconditional replacement probability.
remainingConditions: EA sharing must be enabled (preinstall rule or strategy; normal strategy has a configurable start level, fallback 16).
Extra word exists in this level extra data, is not already collected, length >=2 and within current answer length range, and is not in onlyExtra.
Replacement target has the same length, is not in MustWords, and matches all already revealed letters at their positions.
Target returned by selection must not be in DefineTipWord.
Orderly mode also preserves length/lexical ordering between adjacent answer entries; disorderly mode skips this neighbor-order check.
extraAction.swap: Extra spelling becomes an answer with existing slots; displaced answer moves into the extra representation/config; selection is then judged as Answer.

letterAction.experiment: half_level_easier_test3 == 2, after all common and churn gates
letterAction.android: IsInAndroid returns constant true in this supplied native build; no additional 50% lottery here.
letterAction.selection: Uniform random index over all eligible positions, not uniform over words.
letterAction.wordEligibility: Word not in AnswerProgress and has >1 remaining positions after excluding special cells and PropsFindWord.
letterAction.persistence: Append position (wordIndex*100+letterIndex) to PropsFindWord, restored into grid by GameRestore.
letterAction.cost: No coin, item, ad debit or HintCount increment in this helper.
letterAction.noCandidate: Returns false; the caller continues to the extra-pool action.
letterAction.otherPlatformBranch: Unreachable on supplied Android build: churn>.5 direct; .3<churn<=.5 with 50%; <=.3 none. Not an iOS runtime verification.

repeat.extraPool: Already moved words stay moved in the restored config; empty onlyExtra has nothing more to move.
repeat.letter: Can reveal another eligible position after a later qualifying re-entry. No fixed count cap in this helper; eligibility stops before the last ordinary unrevealed letter of each unfinished word.
repeat.attemptReset: Trigger does not clear AnswerProgress, ExtraProgress or TrialAttemptsCount.
repeat.scope: Current restored level; changing/completing the level creates/clears per-level state. Decay date is in PlayData, separate from per-level restore data.

warmup.start: ColdStartApp calls daily reorder and daily deletion setup; controlled by separate strategy switches and WarmBeginDay vs PlayDays.
warmup.reorder: 15-position upcoming window; select 3 lowest configured SinglePlayConfig.time values, move their positions to front. Existing restored level is skipped.
warmup.delete: Main level indices 7..1000, per-level WaitDeleteWordNum indexed by offset from WarmBeginReduceLevelIndex. The supplied T1/T1_WordTime rows have 3 entries.
warmup.whichWords: Listed timeOrder candidates; remove from answer and add to extra.
warmup.floor: English retains at least 4 answers; other languages retain at least 3.
warmup.caveat: Both paths share WarmBeginDay, and reorder setup runs first; do not assume both effects stack for every strategy.

verificationLimits: Static native-code analysis; Android app not executed.
Account experiment assignment and backend churn model are unavailable.
No verified main-ELO-controlled increase/decrease of the five level banks.

otherConsumers.gameplay: Two risk probability gates in MainPlayHandler. The same helper contains a non-Android reveal gate unreachable in this Android binary.
otherConsumers.genericExperimentInput: AbUserTagManager.generaAbUserTagData merges all tags including remote tags into the A/B input. Bundled abtest_config and decoded strategy had no explicit churn_prob rule.
otherConsumers.genericAnalytics: UserTagDataManager.e -> all tag map -> sc.c.b -> setEventProperty(learnings_user_tags). This is a generic analytics-property path, not proof of model inputs.
otherConsumers.group2Assignment: Bundled strategy: version >= 2.26 and reward_propensity in [level0_0-1, level1_1-4] -> half_level_easier_test2=2.
notEstablished: Direct churn-based increase in future level difficulty
